notes.title: Saturday Update: Driving Preview [NEW DEMO!]

Hi everyone,

notes.title: Update: YouTube Music Now Available!
notes.content:
Hi guys! First of all, thanks for all the support and interest in Retro Ride during the Racing Fest. We're super happy to hear you're enjoying the game.

We have finally released one of our most anticipated features: the YouTube music integration! Want to listen to your own music while exploring Sunset City? From now on, you can do so simply by copy-pasting the YouTube link! Cruise the city to your favorite playlist and navigate the streets to the beats you know and love.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/khzTCsG/Screenshot-4.jpg[/img]

Make sure to join the fun in Discord and speak to the devs and the whole team behind Retro Ride!
